name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_network_status_changed
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::OnNetworkStatusChanged handles WOL connection status changes, abort-on-disconnect, and async error flagging.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x440f40 validates the two-argument stdcall callback contract, status-name selection for WOL connection codes, sprintf("Net Status = %s (%d)\n", statusName, connectionStatusCode), zGame::ReturnOnlyStub call, SetAbortAndClose when status is 0x4012f and g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeAbortFlag is 0, async error flagging for 0x80040069, 0x80040067, and 0x8004006a, and return value 0.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_network_status_changed_smoke patches zGame::ReturnOnlyStub and SetAbortAndClose and verifies async-error flagging for 0x80040069, no async flag for 0x80040068, abort-and-close behavior for 0x4012f when not already aborting, suppression when already aborting, normal connected status behavior, and return value.
